column1: # Change 0642 four-way differential, BEFORE leg (base c7326f68).
# xlsx0642 diff FILE..., taskset -c 17. One row per worksheet of every .xlsx in
# the tree plus the probe corpus. Each leg opens its own SourceBackedWorkbook
# (or eager Workbook) and reports ok:<visited>:<FNV-1a digest over the Debug
# rendering of every (address, cell) pair in production order>, or
# refused:<the refusal's Display text>. `agree` is yes when all four legs
# Legs: cold_visit = visit_cells on a cold worksheet; cold_cells = cells() on a
# cold worksheet; warm_visit = visit_cells after stored_extent() published the
# materialized store; eager_cells = litchi_xlsx::Workbook's own store iterator.
# This file and diff-after.tsv are byte-identical.
